name: Multi-agent orchestration
purpose: It solves the problem of single AI agents hitting a ceiling in handling complex, multi-step business challenges by enabling specialized agents to collaborate. This approach ensures that AI investments are scalable and reliable, transforming a patchwork of tools into a unified system that drives results.
keyCapabilities: Collaboration and communication protocols (e.g., A2A, MCP)
integrations: CRM, ERP, HR, and regulatory systems
